main.description: Submit a design job. Uploads input images (B2 blob keys) and queues a Zero-To-CAD synthesis job (Apache 2.0, license_tier=apache2).

inputImages.description: B2 blob keys for input images. Multi-view: 8 images (4 front + 4 rear, 256x256). Single-view: 1 image.

inputType.description: Number of input views. multi-view (recommended) produces higher-quality STEP.

orgDid.description: Org ERC725 DID for RLS scoping.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes for the design job.

autoExportToTsukuru.description: If true, automatically submit artifact to tsukuru supplierExchange on completion (only Apache 2.0 artifacts).
